name: check6_h3_image_4096

inputs.sigmas: the PDD grid of pdd_config.json, the sampler's sigmas and the step sigmas
inputs.euler: x + (sigma_next - sigma) v in float32, the velocity in float32
inputs.noise: numpy Generator(PCG64(seed)).standard_normal(shape, dtype=float32), NCHW, shape (1, 24, size / 16, size / 16)
inputs.latents: (1, 24, size / 16, size / 16) float32 in model space, after the step
inputs.dequant: ComfyUI-GGUF dequantize_tensor with dequant_dtype float32: K-quant block math in float32, on every call
inputs.matmul_bf16: bf16 operands, float32 GEMM, one bf16 rounding

oracle.bf16_features: the fp32 tap cast to bfloat16

1.measured: the largest relative L2 between gmlx's exact run and the same run from the noise and features nudged by one float32 step (4 seeds), after the step; tests/image/test_image_check6_h3_image.py _floor on minimax_h3_image_pruned-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf 90616d8c, Apple M5 Max

2.measured: the largest relative L2 between gmlx's exact run and the same run from the noise and features nudged by one float32 step (4 seeds), after the step; tests/image/test_image_check6_h3_image.py _floor on minimax_h3_image_pruned-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf 90616d8c, Apple M5 Max

3.measured: the largest relative L2 between gmlx's exact run and the same run from the noise and features nudged by one float32 step (4 seeds), after the step; tests/image/test_image_check6_h3_image.py _floor on minimax_h3_image_pruned-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf 90616d8c, Apple M5 Max

4.measured: the largest relative L2 between gmlx's exact run and the same run from the noise and features nudged by one float32 step (4 seeds), after the step; tests/image/test_image_check6_h3_image.py _floor on minimax_h3_image_pruned-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf 90616d8c, Apple M5 Max

5.measured: the largest relative L2 between gmlx's exact run and the same run from the noise and features nudged by one float32 step (4 seeds), after the step; tests/image/test_image_check6_h3_image.py _floor on minimax_h3_image_pruned-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf 90616d8c, Apple M5 Max

6.measured: the largest relative L2 between gmlx's exact run and the same run from the noise and features nudged by one float32 step (4 seeds), after the step; tests/image/test_image_check6_h3_image.py _floor on minimax_h3_image_pruned-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf 90616d8c, Apple M5 Max

tolerances.rule: latents after every step. At 1024: gmlx's bf16 run at relative L2 twice the oracle's own bf16 against fp32 relative L2 after that step. At any other size: gmlx's exact fp32 run against the fp32 latents at the larger of exact_rel_l2 and twice gmlx's own exact floor, and its bf16 run read as a share of the 1024 gate of the step, not gated

notes: oracle: ComfyUI 2aa4d535a76e4b6acf6a94f263bc482430c396dd, ComfyUI-GGUF 373048b8403a7820620065210a691263d4da0a61, UnetLoaderGGUF with dequant_dtype float32
oracle_dit is dit with the config key {"transformer": {"pdd_steps": 6, "pdd_sigmas": [...]}} and every tensor unchanged
